policy_prompt_for_subgoal: An episode starts in subgoal A (pick up the cube). Rules, applied to whatever the step shows: Whether the cube is held is decided from the fingers and gripper at the scene of this decision step alone, never from the cube's own line: the cube IS held whenever the fingers are ~46% open (any partly closed value, not ~100%) and the gripper is raised (height above ~0.1), even if the cube line lacks the words 'held in the gripper' or still reports its old table coordinates; the execution steps leading to that scene show the gripper descending to the cube, the fingers closing from ~100% to ~46%, and the gripper rising. The cube is NOT held only when the fingers are ~100% open. 1. If the goal-named cube is NOT held (fingers ~100% open): choose A, pick up the cube, pointing at the current position of the goal-named cube as shown in the scene at this decision step (typically near [82, 127] at the start of execution). This is always the case at the first decision step. 2. If the goal-named cube IS held (fingers ~46% open and gripper raised, by the test above): choose B, drop onto, pointing at the target listed in the current scene whose position is closest to goal_target from memory (targets wobble by a few pixels between frames). If goal_target is unknown, apply rule 4. 3. Never choose C (press the button); the button is part of the demonstration only, not of the task. 4. If the situation matches no rule (e.g. the cube is held but goal_target is unknown, or the cube is not visible): if a cube is held, drop onto the target nearest the image centre; otherwise choose A pointing at the goal-named cube's last visible position. After a drop has been completed the episode is over; if asked again, repeat rule 1 or 2 as the scene dictates.

fields.name: goal_target
fields.description: At the first decision step (demonstration frames are shown and the carried memory is empty), scan the demonstration frames in ascending t for the cube whose colour the goal instruction names. Each time the fingers open from a partly closed value (~46%) to ~100% in a frame after frames where that cube was 'held in the gripper', that is one release; its target is the one closest to where the cube rests in the frames right after the release, read from a frame listing all four targets (the demo's last frames do). Skip button presses (fingers 0% open, no cube held), skip the demonstration's final release, which leaves the cube near the image centre around [82, 127] with no target under it, and do not count a frame where the cube merely loses its 'held' label while the gripper stays raised. Number the remaining releases earliest first, take the entry the goal's ordinal names ('first' = 1, 'second' = 2, 'third' = 3, 'fourth' = 4), and write that target's [y, x]. At every later step copy the carried-in value unchanged. unknown only if no demonstration frames are shown and nothing is carried in. e.g. [107, 86]
